basic_details.job_title: Mumbai Port Authority Financial Analyst Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Mumbai Port Authority is recruiting candidates for 3 Financial Analyst vacancies on a contract basis. Eligible applicants must send their offline application, along with self-attested copies of certificates and documents, to the Mumbai Port Authority, Finance Department before the last date of 10 November 2026. Candidates applying for the Financial Analyst post must be Qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) or Qualified Cost & Management Accountants (CMA). The notified pay for the post is Rs. 60,000 plus Rs. 15,000 transportation allowance, and the maximum age limit for the post is 30 years. Sel

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in offline mode to the Mumbai Port Authority Finance Department. Candidates must enclose self-attested copies of educational and professional certificates, proof of date of birth, and experience documents along with the filled application form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) / Qualified Cost & Management Accountants (CMA). Age Limit: The maximum age limit for the post is 30 years. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection of eligible candidates will be made through an interview before a panel comprising two Officers from the Finance Department and one Officer from the GAD Department. Appointment is subject to the candidate being found medically fit as per Mumbai Port Authority requirements and satisfactory verification of police antecedents.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Financial Analyst post?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies available for the Financial Analyst post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of application is 10.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Qualified Chartered Accountants (CA) or Qualified Cost & Management Accountants (CMA).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Financial Analyst post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration offered for this position?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 60,000/- per month plus Rs. 15,000/- transportation allowance.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be made through an interview of the eligible candidates by a panel comprising two Officers from the Finance Department and one Officer from the GAD Department.

faq.question: Q7. Is the job permanent or on a contract basis?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contract basis for a period of one year, subject to performance review every year, and is extendable by another year at a time at the discretion of the port.

faq.question: Q8. What type of medical facility is provided to the contractual employee?
faq.answer: Emergency medical treatment will be provided at MbPA Hospital or dispensary in case of accident while on duty.

faq.question: Q9. What is the leave entitlement for contractual employees?
faq.answer: Contractual employees are entitled to 12 days Casual Leave in a year and Public Holidays.
